text:
Matvei Michkov is 21, has 11 goals in 26 games, and the trade calls are apparently coming in anyway. Markerzone and HockeyFeed both reported that Flyers general manager Daniel Briere has turned teams away. You can see why: our wins-added measure has him 23rd of 560 skaters, his goals swinging games well beyond what the chances alone would predict.

His card is a strange pair of opposite luck flags. His own finishing is running hot, 11 goals on 6.4 expected and a 29% shooting rate after 12% last season, and our range puts his true rate between 12% and 17%. Meanwhile Philadelphia has scored 9.5 fewer goals than its chances deserved when he's on the ice, which has taken points away. The bigger worry is that the Flyers get out-chanced badly with him at five on five, under 43% of the expected goals.

The last ten games show the turn: one goal, seven assists, at about 17 minutes a night. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at the home-plate area at an 88th percentile rate last season. Watch the goal rate settle and the assists hold; that's the more durable version of him.
